findings.title: [cross-lane] Root AGENTS.md map and its Facebook-login rule omit the ERP fleet (apps/fleet-agent, apps/backend/src/fleet, /api/fleet), which now runs the live Facebook workers
findings.evidence: apps/fleet-agent/ (README, Dockerfile, src/) exists and is in no row of the Map table; nothing in AGENTS.md or docs/agents/ names it (grep 'fleet-agent' finds none). apps/fleet-agent/README.md:58,81,114 say every worker start is a Facebook login, and the agent starts, replaces and removes workers based on ERP state (/api/fleet/hosts desired.count, /api/fleet/releases). apps/backend/src/fleet/workers.ts:338 adds POST /api/fleet/workers/:id/relogin, and workers.ts:213-308 adds slot remove/retire/park/unpark. trackers/facebook/CHANGELOG.md 0.15.0 'Removed' retired the 25 unhealthy legacy workers on 2026-10-27; B3 notes say all 41 legacy roster workers are retired and the homelab now runs 9 rs-fleet-homelab containers under rs-fleet-agent. B3-01 counts 31 boot logins in 24 h, 20 ending challenged, locked or failed, driven by fleet count changes. AGENTS.md:22-31 lists only docker restart/compose/deploy.sh/rsc fleet release, coordinator relogin (/v1/workers/{id}/relogin) and session files. trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md:113-122 still says deploy.sh 'restarts the workers'.
findings.failure_scenario: An agent asked to 'get more workers running' or 'roll the new worker image' follows the documented rule, sees nothing about the ERP Hosts tab, host capacity, POST /api/fleet/releases or the fleet-agent, and changes a host count or starts a release. Each start or replacement is a boot login (B3-01: 20 of 31 in a day were challenged or locked), and the account can be lost. The Map also gives no AGENTS.md entry point for apps/fleet-agent, so its own login traps (docker rm rs-fleet-*, FLEET_STAGGER_SECONDS) are never read.
findings.proposed_fix: AGENTS.md:22, after the 'Starting a worker container' bullet, add: "- **Anything that makes the ERP fleet start a worker.** The fleet-agent (`apps/fleet-agent/`, one `rs-fleet-agent` container per host) starts, replaces and removes `rs-fleet-*` workers to match the ERP. So raising or lowering a host's capacity or `authoritative` flag (Monitors ▸ Facebook ▸ Hosts, `/api/fleet/hosts`), a release (`POST /api/fleet/releases`), a slot unpark/resume, `POST /api/fleet/workers/{id}/relogin`, and `docker rm rs-fleet-<id>` on a host are each a login." AGENTS.md Map: add the row "| `apps/fleet-agent/` | Fleet host agent: runs the ERP fleet's Facebook worker containers on each Docker host | TypeScript, Node 24, docker CLI | homelab `10.10.10.73` and `worker@10.10.60.14`, image `ghcr.io/jinhuw/fleet-agent:<root version>` | root | [apps/fleet-agent/README.md](apps/fleet-agent/README.md) |", and change row 50 to "... + the legacy coordinator fleet (workers retired 2026-10-27; live workers belong to the ERP fleet)". trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md:113: add "The legacy compose workers were retired on 2026-10-27; live workers are the ERP fleet's (`apps/fleet-agent/`)."
findings.regression_test: docs-lint: a test that fails when a top-level directory under apps/ or trackers/ has no row in the AGENTS.md Map table.

findings.title: [cross-lane] The rs_console contract docs miss facebookPool.ts, the ERP caller that seeds sessions and triggers restore or re-login
findings.evidence: apps/backend/src/routes/facebookPool.ts:32 imports callFacade from ./coordinator. It calls GET /v1/fleet (:538), PUT /v1/accounts/{id} (:656), PUT /v1/workers/{id}/session (:680), POST /v1/workers/{id}/restore-session (:689), POST /v1/workers/{id}/relogin (:694) and GET /v1/logins (:836). rs_console serves PUT /v1/workers/{worker_id}/session (rs_console/rs_console/app.py:360) and POST /v1/workers/{worker_id}/restore-session (app.py:281), plus POST /v1/vnc/{id}/ticket, which vncBridge.ts:120 uses. trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md:45-77 lists every other route but none of these three. AGENTS.md:72 names only routes/coordinator.ts, vncBridge.ts and fleet/proxyHealth.ts as the ERP side.
findings.failure_scenario: Someone reshapes or tightens /v1/workers/{id}/session or restore-session on the console side while trusting the 'Forwarded today' list. The Pool Assign flow then breaks: cookie-first Assign falls back to POST /relogin (facebookPool.ts:694), a password login, on every assign. Or the endpoints are removed as unused. A reviewer checking the contract test also misses that facebookPool.ts has no row.
findings.proposed_fix: AGENTS.md:72 first cell: append ", and the account pool's Assign / credential / ledger calls in `routes/facebookPool.ts`"; Test cell: append ", `apps/backend/tests/facebook-pool*.test.ts`" (whichever covers Assign). trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md:57, after the relogin bullet, add: "- `PUT /v1/workers/{id}/session` (`{cookie, reason}`: seal a pool account's cookie as the worker's restorable session) and `POST /v1/workers/{id}/restore-session` (restore it, the gentle Re-login); both come from the ERP's Pool Assign (`routes/facebookPool.ts`). A restore is a login." and "- `POST /v1/vnc/{id}/ticket` (single-use ticket for the VNC websocket, `vncBridge.ts`)."
findings.regression_test: Contract test that greps every callFacade(...) path in apps/backend/src and asserts each appears in trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md 'Forwarded today'.

findings.title: backup/README.md and backup/railway.toml call the R2 backup cron `db-sync`, but `db-sync` is the prod→dev copy; the backup service is `pg-r2-backup`
findings.evidence: B1 lists the services of recycle-erp-experiment: pg-r2-backup 3224fca5 (last success 2026-10-31 03:30:51Z, tracks main) and db-sync 006cd405 (the dev-env prod→dev sync, last success 2026-10-27, B1-03). deploy/railway-sync/railway.toml:1 and docs/deployment-railway-dev-prod.md:16 also call the sync `db-sync`, and docs/deployment-railway-cloudflare-backups.md:5,53 call the backup `pg-r2-backup`. docs/agents/erp-ops.md:44 tells readers to look for 'fleet NOT restored' in 'the db-sync log', which is the sync.
findings.failure_scenario: Someone checking whether backups ran opens db-sync's logs per backup/README.md:3. Since 2026-10-27 those are failed prod→dev syncs (B1-03), so they conclude backups are failing and act on the wrong service, or treat the sync's failures as backup noise. Meanwhile the real backup service goes unwatched.
findings.proposed_fix: backup/README.md:3: "A **Railway cron service** (`pg-r2-backup` in the `recycle-erp-experiment` project, production environment; not `db-sync`, which is the prod→dev copy in `deploy/railway-sync/`)". backup/railway.toml:1: "# Railway config-as-code for the `pg-r2-backup` service (the daily Postgres -> R2".

findings.title: Test-database docs point at a gitignored docker-compose.override.yml on 127.0.0.1:5432; the suite reads TEST_DATABASE_URL (recycle-erp-testdb, 55432)
findings.evidence: docker-compose.override.yml is in .gitignore:55-56 and exists in no checkout (neither this worktree nor ~/Projects/recycle_servers_v2/recycle_servres_erp). apps/backend/tests/helpers/global-setup.ts:26-32 takes TEST_DATABASE_URL from the env or the repo-root .env and throws without it. The running test DB is container recycle-erp-testdb on 127.0.0.1:55432, as docs/DATABASE.md:94 and trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md:173-175 say. The doc also names `global-setup.ts` without its helpers/ directory.
findings.failure_scenario: A fresh clone follows apps/backend/AGENTS.md, has no override file, and can't make 5432 reachable (docker-compose.yml:12-13 deliberately publishes no port). Or they publish 5432 by hand while TEST_DATABASE_URL points elsewhere, and global-setup throws 'TEST_DATABASE_URL not set'.
findings.proposed_fix: apps/backend/AGENTS.md:192-193: "They need `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (repo-root `.env`), normally the `recycle-erp-testdb` container on `127.0.0.1:55432` (`docker run -d --name recycle-erp-testdb -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=… -p 127.0.0.1:55432:5432 postgres:18`).  Production compose publishes no Postgres port." and change `global-setup.ts` to `tests/helpers/global-setup.ts` at :196 and :200. docs/agents/erp-ops.md:54-56: "…over the compose net.  Host-side tests use their own `recycle-erp-testdb` container on `127.0.0.1:55432`.  Never bind Postgres to `0.0.0.0`."

findings.title: DATABASE.md misses columns from migrations 0209, 0215, 0219 and 0220, plus the fleet_slots_claim_idx unique index
findings.evidence: I built all three schemas from scratch (ERP: migrate.mjs, 218 files, head 0220; Reddit: migrate.ts, head 0008; coordinator: Database(SCHEMA + *_EXTRA_COLUMNS)) and diffed them against every #### section and column row. All 91/19/33 tables match. Every column type and NOT NULL flag matches, except these 14 columns, which have no row: after_sales_cases.currency_code char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD' CHECK IN ('USD','CNY') (0220); fleet_hosts.agent_instance text, agent_daemon text, agent_seen_at timestamptz (0209:9-11); fleet_proxy_checks.city, region, country, org text (0215); reddit_leads.sales, buys integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, latest_post_title, latest_post_url text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' (0219); reddit_lead_buyers.sales, buys integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. Index fleet_slots_claim_idx = UNIQUE (host_id, claim_id) WHERE claim_id IS NOT NULL (0207) is not under :2401. The SQL-function table (:2690-2709) lacks fleet_archive_attempt and fleet_fence_pool_owner, which are only described in prose at :2472/:2489, and reddit_lead_events_lock (prose at :2635).
findings.failure_scenario: Someone writing a report SQL from DATABASE.md sums after_sales_cases.amount as USD, but since 0220 RMB cases exist. Or they miss the claim uniqueness the fleet's slot claim relies on and hand-insert a duplicate claim.
findings.proposed_fix: Add rows as above to each table (e.g. after :1400 table: "| `currency_code` | `char(3)` | ✓ | `'USD'` | Currency `amount` is in: USD or CNY (v1.395.0). |"; fleet_hosts: "| `agent_instance` | `text` |  |  | The agent instance that holds the host; a second instance is refused while this one keeps calling. |", "| `agent_daemon` | `text` |  |  | The Docker daemon id the instance reported. |", "| `agent_seen_at` | `timestamptz` |  |  | When that instance last called. |"). Change :2401 to "- **Indexes:** `fleet_slots_host_id_idx` (host_id), `fleet_slots_proxy_id_idx` (proxy_id), unique `fleet_slots_claim_idx` (host_id, claim_id) WHERE claim_id IS NOT NULL". Add the three functions to the :2690 table.
findings.regression_test: A docs/review-2026-10-31/repro-style check, kept as a CI script: build the schema, then diff information_schema.columns against DATABASE.md's column rows (the script used here: parse '#### `t`' plus '| `col` |').

findings.title: DATABASE.md 'As of' line, the Overview table counts and the migration count are stale
findings.evidence: :11 says ERP migration 0219, Reddit 0007, Facebook tracker 0.13.18; the heads are 0220_after_sales_currency.sql, 0008_user_sender_owner.sql and VERSION 0.15.0. :41 gives the ERP 69 tables; the built schema has 90 base tables + 1 view (fleet_minutes). :43 gives the coordinator 32 tables; Database() creates 33. :105-106 says '203 numbers, 201 files'; there are 218 files over 0001-0220.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader uses the As-of line to decide which migrations still need documenting and skips 0220 and reddit 0008. The table counts make the doc look like it is missing ~22 ERP tables, so a reviewer distrusts sections that are actually current.
findings.proposed_fix: :11-12: "**As of 2026-10-31:** ERP migration `0220`, Reddit tracker migration `0008`, Facebook tracker `0.15.0`." :41 last cell: "90 + 1 view". :43 last cell: "33". :105-106: "The numbering has gaps: 220 numbers, 218 files."
findings.regression_test: Same schema-diff script can assert the As-of migration equals the highest file.

findings.title: The long-form Railway runbooks erp-ops.md points to still describe the pre-release setup
findings.evidence: deployment-railway-dev-prod.md:73 says 'Prod deploys also run automatically on pushes to the `prod` branch'. That branch was retired 2026-07-20 (the same file's :3-7, erp-ops.md:89-91): the prod Worker deploys on main. :141 says the sync runs 'after the 03:00 backup', but backup/railway.toml runs it at 30 3 * * * (03:30). deployment-railway-cloudflare.md:3-6 still calls Railway an 'EXPERIMENTAL' second target that 'does not replace the production Docker Compose stack', and :329 says 'do not merge to main'. Railway recycle-erp-experiment is production (AGENTS.md:45, B1). erp-ops.md:7-8 points at both files as the long-form runbooks with no caveat.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator reads deployment-railway-cloudflare.md, takes Docker Compose for production, and treats a Railway incident as an experiment outage. Or they push to `prod` expecting a Worker deploy that never happens.
findings.proposed_fix: deployment-railway-dev-prod.md:73-74: "Prod deploys also run automatically on pushes to `main` (`.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml`, …)"; :141: "`0 4 * * *` (after the 03:30 backup)". deployment-railway-cloudflare.md:3-6: replace the banner with "> **Historical (2026-05).** This was the first Railway + Cloudflare setup. Railway `recycle-erp-experiment` is now production; see docs/deployment-railway-dev-prod.md and docs/agents/erp-ops.md." and drop :329.

notes: Method: a script pulled every backticked or linked path from the target docs and resolved it against the repo; I checked the unresolved ones by hand (most were shorthand relative to a package dir, all fine apart from C2-04 and C2-07). I grepped the source for every symbol, env var and file named in apps/backend/AGENTS.md and apps/frontend/AGENTS.md; all exist. trackers/reddit/AGENTS.md checks out completely: allowlist = tracker.ts, tests, debug notes, port 5433, container name, allowBuilds, RESPONSE_SCHEMA_ID. session-isolation.md matches new-session.sh (flags, LOCAL_FILES, 8h TTL, .locks/.select). erp-ops.md: all files, the CMD exec, csp-rev, TOPICS thread ids, the ERROR_LOG_DIR mount and prevent_destroy match. DATABASE.md: I built the schemas in a disposable postgres:18 (review1031-C2 on 55622, removed afterwards) through each project's own runner. The coordinator schema came from a scratch SQLite Database() instance, since no venv with psycopg exists; pg.py renders the same SCHEMA, so the Postgres DDL was not checked separately. No live resources were touched in this lane; Railway service names and the legacy-roster retirement come from B1/B3 evidence. Not covered: trackers/facebook/deploy/README.md and trackers/reddit/infra/README.md (the tracker lanes' runbooks), and DATABASE.md prose meanings beyond the spot checks. Already raised elsewhere, so not repeated: COORDINATOR_ACCESS_* optional (B1), fbc-api Access bypass (B2), Facebook debug-note location at AGENTS.md:227 (C3).
